name: Steep
description: Steep MCP lets Claude query your semantic layer. Retrieve metrics, targets, dimensions, and workspace data — keeping your analytics accessible and in context while you work. Compose findings into shareable Steep reports.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Steep to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Steep to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.steep.app/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Steep MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Steep lists 14 MCP tools, including create_report, get_metric, get_report, list_entities, list_metrics, list_modules, list_reports, list_targets, list_workspace_members, list_workspace_teams, query_metric, and query_target.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Steep?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Steep in data-analytics on the Manufact MCP catalog include Epicure, Newsflash, Point Topic, Pricing Optimizer AI, and StatCite.
Steep requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Steep is developed by Steep. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
